    Broadband in Wakefield

    Wakefield broadband from OCCTA starts with the address, not a city-wide promise. This page is for homes in places such as City centre, Sandal, Agbrigg, and for postcode districts including WF1, WF2, WF3. Sandal and Outwood are the residential areas people usually mean, and they are separate checks from the centre. Price Lock 24 and Flex 30 are the plan styles OCCTA can offer where the address is eligible. The availability checker is what confirms technology, setup and the price for that door.

    Availability note: Plans shown are current OCCTA offers and may not all be available at every address. Final availability, speed and network technology are subject to network and supplier validation. If your selected plan cannot be supplied, we’ll email you with available options before provisioning and won’t change your plan or price without your agreement. If confirmed, your order proceeds as submitted.

    01Local guide

    Wakefield areas and postcodes

    Leeds has its own page. Pontefract is a nearby town. Use the town written on the address. Public speed bands go up to 1000Mbps only where that product is available, and the from-price of £34.99 a month is the national Price Lock 24 headline, not a Wakefield-only offer. If you are actually in Leeds, Barnsley, Pontefract, run the checker on that address rather than assuming this Wakefield page answers it.

    Local areas
    City centre, Sandal, Agbrigg, Outwood, Lupset.
    Postcode districts
    WF1, WF2, WF3. These are Royal Mail districts, not a coverage guarantee.
    Nearby towns
    Leeds, Barnsley, Pontefract, Dewsbury. Use the checker on the full address if you live just outside Wakefield.

    Availability is checked per address, not per postcode
